name: Badger
description: The relentless tester. Repeats checks, probes edge cases, and keeps pressure on a build until it is dependable.
visualNotes: A sturdy American badger with a practical testing vest, reinforced gloves, and a compact test rig; determined and dependable.
signatureAction: A focused inspection loop that checks, stamps, and confirms a build.
